label: Fictional October demonstration — all levels and moves synthetic, not actual market closes
commentary: Fictional demonstration growth scare: assumed haven demand lowers government yields while credit spreads widen, equities fall and EUR weakens. Every level and move is invented for this synthetic scenario, not a report of October events. Parallel rates, common equity returns and constant synthetic sensitivities are modeling assumptions. Credit prior levels are current less change; FX prior level is current divided by (1 + return/100); equity prior index is normalized to 100.
